title: Deliver, reveal, claim on paper
spec: Add src/payee/deliver.ts: deliverAndReveal({ state, preimage, deliverable, post, rail, notes, surface }) posts the deliverable as chunked lines (u-payee-07) to the deal surface (the deal room, or the deliveries room with a contract tag when the surface is the board), then posts the reveal frame, calls rail.claim(ref, preimage), and moves the tclk state note locked→claimed with CAS (failure is logged, not fatal). Returns the folded state after the reveal. Order matters: deliverable before reveal, always.
done: On the fixture, the write log shows deliverable lines before the reveal and the rail receipt says claimed.
